limitations: Synthetic speech is an audition for naturalness, not a human voice recording.
Very short utterances and long chunks can reduce prosody quality; render dialogue in sensible sentence groups.
Scientific terms and character-name pronunciation need review.
No emotional acting or lipsync is inferred from this audio alone.
